title: #226 Foreign Cultures
prompt: With the development of globalization, the cultural communication between countries is becoming more and more frequent. Are you for or against foreign cultures? Support your ideas with your own experience.

promptSegments.text: With the development of globalization, the cultural communication between countries is becoming more and more frequent.
Are you for or against foreign cultures?
Support your ideas with your own experience.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Learning about other cultures helps people see different ways of life.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning about other cultures helps people see different ways of life.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Talking to people from other countries helps people understand them better.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Talking to people from other countries helps people understand them better.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Learning about foreign cultures is beneficial because it exposes us to various ways of life, such as different food traditions, allowing us to learn from others.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning about foreign cultures is beneficial because it exposes us to various ways of life, such as different food traditions, allowing us to learn from others.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Exposure to different traditions broadens our understanding of the world, helping us accept the unique meaning and value of every culture.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Exposure to different traditions broadens our understanding of the world, helping us accept the unique meaning and value of every culture.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cultural exchange is beneficial because it broadens our minds by exposing us to new points of view and different ways of life, leading to a deeper understanding of human existence.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cultural exchange is beneficial because it broadens our minds by exposing us to new points of view and different ways of life, leading to a deeper understanding of human existence.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, cultural communication strengthens personal bonds by creating common ground through shared experiences, which teaches mutual respect and appreciation for diverse lifestyles.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, cultural communication strengthens personal bonds by creating common ground through shared experiences, which teaches mutual respect and appreciation for diverse lifestyles.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Cultural exchange helps us grow as individuals.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Cultural exchange helps us grow as individuals.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Learning about foreign cultures improves communication ability.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Learning about foreign cultures improves communication ability.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
